game.title: Injustice 2
game.blurb: Superhero fighting game from NetherRealm Studios (RAWG also lists Warner Bros. Interactive and QLOC), released 2017-05-09. RAWG average playtime: 6 hours. Genres: Fighting. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Story Mode
chapters.summary: Clearing half and then all of Story mode, and replaying it with every alternate path.

chapters.title: Arenas, Moves and Training
chapters.summary: Arena transitions, background bounces, Supermoves, ducking, dodging hits and the training categories.

chapters.title: Character Finishers
chapters.summary: Winning with each fighter's signature move as the final hit, plus the hidden character challenges.

chapters.title: Added Fighters
chapters.summary: Finishers for the fighters StrategyWiki marks as DLC, such as Red Hood, Starfire, Sub-Zero, Hellboy, Darkseid and the Ninja Turtles.

chapters.title: Multiverse, Guilds and Battle Simulator
chapters.summary: Multiverse events, joining a Guild, Mother Boxes, AI Battle Simulation and every ending in the Battle Simulator.

chapters.title: Gear and Levels
chapters.summary: Collecting and selling gear, Player XP and character levels.

chapters.title: Online Play
chapters.summary: Ranked and player matches, King of the Hill and online comebacks.

StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Injustice_2
Fandom (injustice.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://injustice.fandom.com/wiki/Injustice_2
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). The Steam schema for app 627270 is named "QLOC Test App 2"; the store list confirms the app as "Injustice™ 2". RAWG lists Android and iOS among the platforms; nothing in the Steam or wiki data confirms those, so check before showing platforms. StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0): only Controls and Table of Contents are written; its Walkthrough and all character pages are linked but not written. Its contents page marks Atom, Black Manta, Darkseid, Enchantress, Hellboy, Raiden, Red Hood, Starfire, Sub-Zero and the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles as DLC, which is the only source for the "Added Fighters" chapter (page names only). injustice.fandom.com answers the API under "Injustice 2" with about 130 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 5 of 74 Steam achievements are hidden. In a fighting game they are not story beats: their API names point to King of the Hill (HQ_DETHRONE_A_KING), Batman, every villain, Black Canary and Raiden (RA_SUMMON_KID_THUN), so they sit in the character chapter rather than the story chapter. Most achievements are below 3% on Steam.
